groups.name: Panel collapse state and semantics
groups.rationale: Introduces the core model for panel collapse: what state the rail holds, how to label it, what text badges show, and when to auto-expand for agent responses.
groups.watch: The `agentSpokeAgain` logic must not open the panel when the reviewer's own send arrives; it checks for role being 'agent' and length growth, which catches only agent additions.

groups.name: View format breakpoint logic for panel state
groups.rationale: Refactors the viewport width calculation to account for panel collapse: closed panel returns a breakpoint 352px lower, so two-column view fits 352px earlier when the panel shuts.
groups.watch: The math subtracts PANEL_WIDTH_PX from the minimum only when collapsed; open panel must use the original 1400px breakpoint, and the gap between the two must be exactly PANEL_WIDTH_PX.

groups.name: Panel rail UI mounting and control
groups.rationale: Creates the rail element that stays visible when the panel collapses, manages its queued badge, and wires it to toggle panel state and request view refresh.
groups.watch: The rail only calls onToggle when collapsed state actually changes, not on every setQueued call; the badge displays count only when panel is collapsed and count is nonzero.

groups.name: Panel mount refactoring for callback integration
groups.rationale: Wraps panel mount options in a single object and adds onPending callback so the rail gets notified when unsent feedback count changes.
groups.watch: onPending fires on every draw, even if count does not change; the rail's setQueued handles no-ops via the state check in its own set function.

groups.name: View toggle refactoring for dynamic room query
groups.rationale: Replaces a static media query with a function so the view toggle checks available room accounting for panel state, and returns a refresh function so main can wire media query listeners.
groups.watch: The toggle must call hasRoom before deciding what format fits; it is no longer listening to its own media query — main now calls refresh when either room query changes.

groups.name: Main wiring for collapse and room queries
groups.rationale: Refactors page element discovery, wires the panel rail, sets up two room queries (one per panel state), calls view refresh when panel collapses or viewport changes, and auto-expands the panel when the agent speaks.
groups.watch: Two media queries fire independently; view refresh must be called on both change events so the format stays correct. The agent-spoke check happens on conversation update, not on view recalculation. Queueing does not open the panel, but agent response does.

groups.name: Layout grid and panel visibility CSS
groups.rationale: Adds the rail as a third column in the body grid, hides the panel and adjusts column widths when collapsed, prevents header text wrapping, and updates media query thresholds for when the toggle hides.
groups.watch: The grid template changes from two columns to three (content, rail, panel), and collapses by setting panel column width to 0 and hiding display. The two media queries at 1399px and 1047px serve different purposes: 1399 for open panel, 1047 for shut; the comment explains the cutoff for hidden toggle.

groups.name: Server template with rail button and initial state
groups.rationale: Renders the rail button with badge and aria attributes, sets initial data-panel='open', and places the rail between diff and panel in the grid.
groups.watch: The rail element must have id 'lsr-panel-rail', class 'lsr-panel-rail', and a child span with class 'lsr-rail-badge'; aria-expanded and aria-label are set by the mount function.

groups.name: Task completion documentation
groups.rationale: Marks the panel collapse feature as done and documents the implementation: rail placement, badge display, dual breakpoints, header truncation behavior, and verification across widths and schemes.
groups.watch: The documented measurements (1100, 1440, both schemes) and the breakpoint delta (352px) must match what is in the code; the todo lists details that should all be present in the implementation above.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
